title: Textures in the raytracer
author: Claude-JG
description: The raytracer samples the texture of a textured triangle with the barycentric coordinates it computes already, nearest or bilinear by the flags, so that raytraced and saved images show textures as OpenGL does.
releaseNotes: The raytracer draws textures as OpenGL does: nearest or linear, repeated or clamped, multiplied with or replacing the color, RGBA as transparency and RGBAMask cut out, also in the shadows; visualizationSettings.openGL.showTextures applies (revision2026c step RG6.11.5)
